correctness.summary: The Jefferson/Janson transfer and Bernoulli generating-function calculation are correct. Bounded seat excesses turn Janson's weak random-house-size limit into convergence of every polynomial moment. The one-coordinate Bernoulli expectation reduces to e^w((e^w-1)/w)^(n-2), and Stirling coefficient extraction yields exactly the displayed probability-vector-independent constant. Independent symbolic checks reproduce -13/12, 5/8, -187/360 and 21/40 at n=3.

limitations: No separate originality claim survives repository chronology.
